cues: Nickel aluminium alloy in alkali, or zinc and hydrochloric acid, replaces chlorine by hydrogen to give benzene.
It works where hydroxide fails because the hydrogen arrives as a neutral atom, not as a nucleophile.
text: Reduction is easy. Nickel aluminium alloy in alkali, or zinc and hydrochloric acid, replaces chlorine by hydrogen to give benzene. It works where hydroxide fails because the hydrogen arrives as a neutral atom, not as a nucleophile.
